title: Mighty 22 Falls
subtitle: Waterfall beside the Mahodand jeep road, Ushu, Upper Swat

landmark.name: Mighty 22 Falls
edits: The fall follows the mapped stream down the DEM slope; its height and form are illustrative (no published height).
The ribbons, foam, spray, pool and wet boulders are illustrative; the boulders are placed by a fixed seed.
No cliff or structure is drawn: nothing rises more than about 4 m above the ground.

sources.name: OpenStreetMap waterfall node 3524615390
sources.use: the point of the falls (within about 0.2 m of the Atlas place point)

osm_use: the Mahodand Lake jeep track (ways 507506230 and 345805207), the waterfall node, the stream and the ford where the stream crosses the road
